blocks.title: Sorting algorithm
blocks.text: Sorting algorithms data ko khaas tarteeb, jaise barhti ya ghatti, mein lagate hain. Sorting aksar doosre kaamon jaise searching aur data analysis ki pehli shart hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Searching se pehle aksar sorting kyun ki jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke binary search jaise tez tareeqe sirf tarteeb wale data par chalte hain.

items: Sorting data ko tarteeb deti aur searching aur analysis ke liye tayyar karti hai.
